description: Identifier of the observation site (see location_reference.csv)
data_source: Project-assigned identifier
synthetic_generation_method: Sequential IDs 1-35 assigned to the chosen landmarks.

data_source: Approximate landmark centroid (analyst knowledge, unverified) + synthetic scatter
synthetic_generation_method: Landmark coordinates are approximations typed in without a verified download; each observation adds clipped Gaussian scatter (sd 70 m, max 200 m).

data_source: Approximate landmark centroid (analyst knowledge, unverified) + synthetic scatter
synthetic_generation_method: Same as latitude.

data_source: Synthetic sampling
synthetic_generation_method: Sampled per location with weights 0.4 + 1.2*activity profile, so all 24 hours appear but busy hours are more common.

data_source: Calendar arithmetic on a synthetic date
synthetic_generation_method: Internal date drawn uniformly from 2024-01-01..2025-12-31 (date itself is not exported); weekday computed from it.

data_source: Derived from day_of_week
synthetic_generation_method: day_of_week >= 5.

data_source: None official (context: Ministry of Tourism publishes state-level visit counts only)
synthetic_generation_method: Peak density by location type x location popularity x hourly profile x weekend multiplier x weather factor x Durga Puja evening uplift x log-normal noise, clipped 0.3-300. Ministry of Tourism states it keeps no spot-wise visit data, so no official crowd figures were used.

description: Normalized historical crime-risk indicator (0-1), relative among the 35 locations
data_source: Analyst-assigned relative index; sanity-checked against NCRB city-level context only
synthetic_generation_method: Fixed per-location index (assumption) plus N(0, 0.03) window-estimation noise, clipped to 0-1. NOT an official statistic. Official anchor is only city-level: NCRB Crime in India 2023 (as reported by PTI) puts Kolkata at 83.9 cognisable crimes per lakh population vs a 19-metro average of 828; no location-level NCRB data exists.

description: Incidents in the 28 days BEFORE the observation, within 500 m, same 6-hour daypart
data_source: Synthetic (simulated history)
synthetic_generation_method: Negative binomial (Poisson with Gamma(3, 1/3) mixing) with mean = location lambda x daypart factor x (1+0.5*popularity)/1.25. Depends on location and daypart only, never on current or future conditions. Absolute levels are NOT calibrated to a verifiable location-level source.

description: Straight-line distance to nearest police facility in reference list
data_source: Computed from approximate facility coordinates (unverified)
synthetic_generation_method: Haversine distance from the scattered observation point to the nearest of 22 police points in facilities_reference.csv. Facility coordinates were entered from general knowledge, not downloaded from OSM or an official directory.

description: Straight-line distance to nearest hospital in reference list
data_source: Computed from approximate facility coordinates (unverified)
synthetic_generation_method: Haversine distance to the nearest of 15 hospitals in facilities_reference.csv (approximate coordinates).

data_source: Synthetic, seasonally calibrated to IMD normals
synthetic_generation_method: Per-hour state sampled with month-specific probabilities: rain probability = 0.012 + 0.00048 x monthly normal precipitation; storm probability elevated in Apr-May afternoons/evenings; cloud probability assumed by season. Not IMD observations.

data_source: Synthetic, calibrated to IMD monthly mean temperature
synthetic_generation_method: Monthly mean (Monthly mean temperature and precipitation normals for Kolkata (Alipore, WMO 42807) as republished by JMA Tokyo Climate Center from India Meteorological Department data; I could not open the original IMD table in the build session.) + assumed diurnal cosine (peak 14:30) + weather offset + N(0, 1.2); clipped 8-44.

data_source: Synthetic, calibrated to IMD monthly precipitation normals
synthetic_generation_method: 0 for clear/cloudy; Gamma(1.3, 2.4) clipped 0.2-25 for rain; Gamma(2.2, 7.0) clipped 4-60 for storm.

data_source: Synthetic, calibrated to IMD 17:30 IST monthly RH normals
synthetic_generation_method: Monthly 17:30 RH normal (IMD, as tabulated on Wikipedia) + assumed diurnal cosine (+/-8) + weather offset + N(0, 4); clipped 25-100.

data_source: Synthetic
synthetic_generation_method: Location-type walking base speed x (0.35 + 0.65/(1+crowd/70)) x log-normal noise, clipped 0.2-6.5; ~8-20% of rows are stationary (0.0).

description: Time spent at the location so far
data_source: Synthetic
synthetic_generation_method: Log-normal (sigma 0.55) around a location-type median x per-location multiplier; clipped 1-300.

data_source: Synthetic; day/night boundary from approximate sunrise/sunset
synthetic_generation_method: Daylight if approximate monthly sunrise <= hour+0.5 < sunset (spot-checked against four IMD city pages). At night, poor lighting with a location-specific probability (+ small storm and late-night park adjustments); never assigned to every night row.

description: 0 Attraction, 1 Market/shopping, 2 Transport hub, 3 Religious, 4 Park/recreation, 5 Commercial, 6 Residential
data_source: Analyst classification
synthetic_generation_method: Manually assigned per landmark.

data_source: Synthetic rule-based label
synthetic_generation_method: Latent score from crime index, incidents, night period, lighting, U-shaped crowd effect, police/hospital distance, weather, heat, isolation interactions, plus N(0, 0.55) unobserved noise; cut at the 45th and 80th percentiles (~45/35/20%). Documented in README.
